observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a white sewing/embroidery machine with a blue floral side panel and an LCD screen, placed on a patterned bedsheet.
The word 'brother' is legible in white script on the machine body in photo 1.
No model number, serial plate, or nameplate text is legible in either photo.
No power cord, foot pedal, embroidery arm/hoop, bobbins, or other accessories are visible in either photo.
The LCD screen shows a colorful image but it is unclear if the machine is powered on or if this is a static screen protector decal.
Both images are watermarked 'Posted on Jiji' and 'Abiolagonimachine', consistent with a resale listing screenshot.

claims.claim: This is a Brother SE630 Computerized Sewing and Embroidery machine
claims.evidence: Brand name 'brother' is visible on the machine in photo 1, but the model number SE630 is not legible in either photo.

risks.risk: Model cannot be confirmed, and price differs greatly between Brother sewing-only and sewing/embroidery combo models.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate/model sticker, usually on the back or base of the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified generic Brother sewing machine, not the higher-value SE630 combo

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or stitch correctly; screen image could be a static decal, not proof of function.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the machine powered on, threading, and completing a test stitch/embroidery pattern

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cord, foot pedal, embroidery hoop/arm, bobbins, USB) that are essential for an embroidery machine and significantly affect value.
risks.proof: Photo of the full accessory set laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit only, accessories assumed missing

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic or mechanical damage (cracks, bent needle bar, feed dog wear) not visible from the two bed-top angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of needle area, bobbin case, and underside of the machine

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial nameplate on the machine
Video of the machine powering on and performing a stitch or embroidery test
Photo of all included accessories (power cord, foot pedal, embroidery hoop, bobbins, manual)
Close-up photos of the needle plate, bobbin area, and machine underside for damage
response.reason: The seller's claimed model (SE630) drives most of the price difference versus a generic Brother sewing machine, but no model number is legible in either photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without it.
